description: Named places worth showing on a circuit map that the OpenStreetMap extract does not label usefully. Each is drawn only when a circuit's map actually reaches it, so nothing is annotated onto a track it is nowhere near. Coordinates are WGS84; the renderer projects them with the same centre as the track being drawn.

landmarks.name: Spur
landmarks.source: OSM way tagged 2240 University Avenue East (Building D); Magnet Forensics is a tenant. Confirmed against the address given, not an OSM name — OSM carries no building called Spur.
